document_metadata.document_title: Technical Guidance Manual for the Implementation of the Watershed Management Ordinance

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Volume control storage equals one (1) inch of stormwater runoff from newly developed impervious surfaces, treated using retention-based volume control practices first, then flow-through practices for any untreated portion. Site detention release rate must not exceed existing runoff rate (or calculated allowable release rate, whichever is smaller). Volume control storage may credit against required site detention volume.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Existing vs proposed runoff comparison (no increase)
Site detention with allowable release rate
Curve number method (CN tables in TGM)
approved_bmp_categories: Flow-through practices (vegetated swales, filter strips, oil/grit separators)

extraction_quality.review_notes: Extracted from MWRD TGM PDF (538 pages; text truncated/encoding degraded for some symbols). Criteria focus on Article 5 volume control (1 inch) and detention release-rate matching. WMO amendments after TGM compile may add detail. Pipeline excerpt repair removed 1 unlocated citation(s).

design_parameters.enrich_notes: Provided corpus excerpts cover Article 6 I/I control, LTOMP/PSP, and Article 7 maintenance—not Article 5 volume-control sizing criteria. BMP types appear mainly in maintenance narrative (porous pavement, infiltration basins/trenches, grassed swales, oil/grit separators). No explicit numeric SCM design parameters (WQv depth, drawdown, media depths, infiltration rates, etc.) in these pages. Monitoring-well spacing for volume control facilities references a numeric interval but text is encoding-corrupted in excerpt.
